title: Specimen Collection (Venipuncture) Fee Schedule — Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing) Outpatient Surgery Refunds
content:
**Contract rate schedule.** When a post-payment denial of outpatient surgery on an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing) is refunded, the venipuncture code 36415 under revenue code 0300 keeps a payer-agreement value read from the charge postings of the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing).

| Payer class | Venipuncture fee per counted unit |
|---|---|
| Commercial PPO Claim | 3.50 USD |
| Commercial HMO Claim | 4.25 USD |
| otherwise (a Marketplace Exchange Plan Claim) | its charges per counted unit times the payer class's expected allowed percentage |

The venipuncture is valued at its counted units times that rate, never above its charges, its counted units being its billed units, or one when it is billed with charges but no units.

*Footnotes to the schedule (hypothetical figures)*
- 2 billed units on a Commercial HMO Claim with charges of 60.00: 2 times 4.25 is 8.50.
- 1 billed unit on a Commercial PPO Claim with charges of 3.00: 3.50 exceeds the charges, so the value is 3.00.
- A line billed with charges of 40.00 but no units counts as one unit.
